description: Seed URLs and review notes for the GX review knowledge corpus. Prefer primary or official sources over summaries.

documents.title: Google Engineering Practices: The Standard of Code Review
documents.seed_notes: Use when deciding whether a finding should block merge or whether the change improves overall code health enough to approve.

documents.title: Google Engineering Practices: What to Look for in a Code Review
documents.seed_notes: Use as the primary universal checklist for design, behavior, complexity, tests, naming, comments, style, consistency, and documentation.

documents.title: Google Engineering Practices: Small CLs
documents.seed_notes: Use when PR size or unrelated edits make a review less reliable.

documents.title: Microsoft Engineering Fundamentals Playbook: Code Reviews
documents.seed_notes: Use for the split between automated checks and human review of architecture, correctness, maintainability, tests, business logic, and team-specific rules.

documents.title: Microsoft Engineering Fundamentals Playbook: Reviewer Guidance
documents.seed_notes: Use for concrete reviewer behavior and checklist-oriented review prompts.

documents.title: GitLab Code Review Guidelines
documents.seed_notes: Use for domain ownership, category-specific reviewers, security/database/frontend specialists, self-review, and technical-impact review.

documents.title: Mozilla Firefox Reviewer Checklist
documents.seed_notes: Use as a practical checklist for correctness, tests, style, security, privacy, resource leaks, performance, threading, compatibility, docs, and accessibility.

documents.title: NIST SP 800-218 Secure Software Development Framework
documents.seed_notes: Use for secure-development process framing, especially PW.7 code review or code analysis based on secure coding standards with discovered issues recorded and triaged.

documents.title: OWASP Application Security Verification Standard
documents.seed_notes: Use for web and API security requirement mapping and stable identifiers for security review findings.

documents.title: OWASP Cheat Sheet Series
documents.seed_notes: Use for implementation-level secure coding questions when reviewing specific security-sensitive code paths.

documents.title: OpenSSF Scorecard
documents.seed_notes: Use for repository-level supply-chain controls: branch protection, CI checks, dependency update hygiene, token permissions, signed releases, fuzzing, and security policy.

documents.title: SLSA Supply-chain Levels for Software Artifacts
documents.seed_notes: Use for build and release provenance review, especially package publishing and CI/CD integrity changes.

documents.title: Google TypeScript Style Guide
documents.seed_notes: Use for TypeScript style, module boundaries, import/export guidance, language-feature choices, naming, and API shape.

documents.title: TypeScript TSConfig Reference
documents.seed_notes: Use for compiler strictness, nullability, module semantics, and unsafe type-system configuration changes.

documents.title: typescript-eslint Typed Linting
documents.seed_notes: Use for deciding when type-aware linting should backstop human review and when its performance cost matters.

documents.title: PEP 8 Style Guide for Python Code
documents.seed_notes: Use as baseline Python readability and style guidance, while leaving mechanical formatting to tools.

documents.title: Google Python Style Guide
documents.seed_notes: Use for larger-project Python conventions around linting, imports, exceptions, typing, docstrings, and tests.

documents.title: mypy Documentation
documents.seed_notes: Use for Python static typing review, especially public function boundaries and complex data structures.

documents.title: Ruff Documentation
documents.seed_notes: Use for automated Python linting/formatting guidance so humans focus on behavior and design.

documents.title: Effective Go
documents.seed_notes: Use for idiomatic Go, naming, formatting, error handling, initialization, methods, interfaces, and concurrency basics.

documents.title: Go Code Review Comments
documents.seed_notes: Use as the directly reusable Go review checklist, especially common comments that are easy to miss in human review.

documents.title: Google Go Style Guide
documents.seed_notes: Use for organization-scale Go readability and maintainability conventions.

documents.title: govulncheck
documents.seed_notes: Use for Go dependency vulnerability review, especially when vulnerable code is transitively reachable.

documents.title: Rust API Guidelines
documents.seed_notes: Use for Rust public API review: naming, interoperability, documentation, predictability, type safety, dependability, debugability, and future proofing.

documents.title: The Rustonomicon
documents.seed_notes: Use for unsafe Rust review, especially invariants the compiler cannot verify.

documents.title: Clippy Documentation
documents.seed_notes: Use for Rust lint-backed review and deciding which issues should be automated.

documents.title: Miri
documents.seed_notes: Use for unsafe-heavy Rust where tests can be run under Miri to detect undefined behavior risks.

documents.title: RustSec Advisory Database
documents.seed_notes: Use for Rust dependency vulnerability review and Cargo.lock audit expectations.
